Baby corn.d: Charred in butter with crushed red pepper, lime zest and salt.
Baby corn.note: Best eaten like corn on the cob.

Caviar on crackers.d: Salmon roe, crème fraîche and chives on crisp water crackers.

Street cart hot dog.d: Steamed bun, mustard, sauerkraut and onions stewed in tomato.
